data.long_meaning: Derived from the Gallic word 'gal' meaning 'strong' or 'ruler'. In Christian contexts, the name Gallard may evoke images of strength, courage, and leadership. The name Gallard carries the meaning “Strong, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gallard usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
